statement.text:
(a) Conjecture: The noncommutative $A$-ideal of a knot $K$ is exactly the an-
nihilator of the colored Jones polynomial $($ the infinite dimensional vector
whose entries are the colored Jones polynomials of $K)$.
(b) $($ AJ Conjecture $)$ Let $A(K; L, M)$ be the $A$-polynomial of the knot $K$, and
$\alpha(K, q; M, L)$ a polynomial of minimal degree in $L$ and co-prime coeffi-
cients that annihilates the colored Jones polynomial $J_{n}(K; q)$. Then

$$
\alpha(K, -1; M, L) = A(K; L, M)
$$

up to a factor depending on $M.$
